an5.83:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.
an5.83:1.3: kuhako ca hoti, lapako ca, nemittiko ca, nippesiko ca, lābhena lābhaṃ nijigiṃsitā ca.
an5.83:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpoca agaru ca abhāvanīyo cā’ti.
an5.83:2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca, garu ca bhāvanīyo ca.
an5.83:2.3: na ca kuhako hoti, na ca lapako, na ca nemittiko, na ca nippesiko, na ca lābhena lābhaṃ nijigiṃsitā.
an5.83:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cāti.
